snippet.title: LEGO® Hero Factory - Invasion From Below Game Trailer!
snippet.description: In Antropolis City a swarm of giant beasts attack the civilians to feed them to their underground queen! Now the heroes must power up in mighty new battle machines. Rescue the lost heroes and civilians. And save Antropolis City from the massive Invasion from Below!
